desc:
Crash or Land ✈️
Fly, crash, or land planes like a real pilot! Experience epic landings, survive intense crashes, and test your skills in the skies. Will you crash… or land? ⚠️ There’s a lot of lag on public servers, so it’s recommended to use private servers. (its free). How to control the missile launcher: a/d to steer left/right, w/s to steer up/down. You need to aim very good on a plane and when the missile has found it target it will become red circel then click f(pc) or ob mobile its automated.
